name: cube-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Cube Core REST API (stdio for local use, Streamable HTTP on AWS Lambda)

scripts.build:
esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/stdio.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
